name: @flowforge/credentials-authorization
description: FlowForge authorization seam (ctx.authorization equivalent): plugin-owned flows that obtain a credential nobody can supply from configuration alone, because getting it requires a conversation with the human — open this page, paste that code, pick an account. Ported from dsh `@deepseek-ai/dsh-authorization` (A8) and rebuilt as an injected-seam design: every originally-cordis host service (Service/Context feathers, dsh-credentials CredentialKey/describeRecord/record-updated, dsh-invariants companion) is expressed as a package-local port plus a real in-memory implementation; the only reused upstream surface is `HarnessError` from @flowforge/llm. Zero @deepseek-ai/* / @cat-cafe/* / @clowder-ai/* runtime references.
